name: Ample Chunk-Peeling Width Classes Definition
statement: A finite nonempty ample $C$ admits a sequence $C=C_0\supsetneq C_1\supsetneq\cdots\supsetneq C_m=\varnothing$ of ample families with $1\le|C_{j-1}\setminus C_j|\le k$ at each step.
hypotheses: Finite nonempty ample classes on the full specified ambient cube, including original constant coordinates. Empty complementary shores have the unique empty allocation. Ordinary witnesses are the integral points of the full native allocation system. Integer k >= 1. This hierarchy increases with k, P_1 = Damp, and its union is Amp.
